lessons.title: Introduction to Ratios
lessons.description: Understand the concept of a ratio and use ratio language to describe a relationship between two quantities.

lessons.title: Unit Rates
lessons.description: Understand unit rate a/b associated with a ratio a:b and solve real-world unit rate problems.

lessons.title: Equivalent Ratios & Ratio Tables
lessons.description: Find equivalent ratios using ratio tables, tape diagrams, and double number line diagrams.

lessons.title: Percents as Rates per 100
lessons.description: Find a percent of a quantity as a rate per 100 and solve problems involving parts, wholes, and percents.

lessons.title: Converting Measurement Units
lessons.description: Use ratio reasoning to convert measurement units across customary and metric systems.

lessons.title: Dividing Fractions by Fractions
lessons.description: Interpret and compute quotients of fractions, and solve word problems involving division of fractions by fractions.

lessons.title: Multi-Digit Decimals & Operations
lessons.description: Fluently divide multi-digit numbers using standard algorithms, and perform operations on decimals.

lessons.title: Greatest Common Factor & Least Common Multiple
lessons.description: Find greatest common factors up to 100 and least common multiples up to 12 using prime factorization.

lessons.title: Negative Numbers & Number Line
lessons.description: Understand positive and negative integers to describe real-world quantities, and graph on number lines.

lessons.title: Absolute Value & Ordering
lessons.description: Interpret absolute value as magnitude and distance from zero, and distinguish comparison from absolute value.

lessons.title: Exponents & Numerical Expressions
lessons.description: Write and evaluate numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents.

lessons.title: Evaluating Algebraic Expressions
lessons.description: Evaluate algebraic expressions at specific values of their variables using the order of operations.

lessons.title: Properties & Equivalent Expressions
lessons.description: Apply properties of operations such as the distributive property to generate equivalent expressions.

lessons.title: Solving One-Variable Equations
lessons.description: Solve one-variable linear equations using inverse operations and check solutions for reasonableness.

lessons.title: Writing & Graphing Inequalities
lessons.description: Write inequalities of the form x > c or x < c to represent constraints, and graph solutions on number lines.

lessons.title: Area of Triangles & Quadrilaterals
lessons.description: Calculate the area of right triangles, acute/obtuse triangles, and special quadrilaterals.

lessons.title: Area of Irregular Polygons
lessons.description: Calculate area of irregular polygons by decomposing into triangles and rectangles.

lessons.title: Volume of Rectangular Prisms with Fractional Edges
lessons.description: Find volume of rectangular prisms with fractional edge lengths using unit cube packing and V = lwh.

lessons.title: Surface Area & Nets
lessons.description: Construct two-dimensional nets and calculate total surface area of prisms and pyramids.

lessons.title: Polygons in Coordinate Plane
lessons.description: Plot polygons in the coordinate plane given coordinates and determine perimeter and side lengths.

lessons.title: Statistical Questions & Variability
lessons.description: Recognize statistical questions and describe data distributions by center, spread, and overall shape.

lessons.title: Measures of Center: Mean, Median
lessons.description: Calculate and interpret measures of center including mean and median in real-world contexts.

lessons.title: Displaying Data: Histograms & Box Plots
lessons.description: Display numerical data in plots on a number line, including dot plots, histograms, and box plots.

lessons.title: Financial Literacy: Managing Money
lessons.description: Apply rates, ratios, and percentages to personal finance, budgeting, and unit price calculations.

lessons.title: Cumulative Word Problems
lessons.description: Solve multi-step cumulative review word problems synthesizing all Grade 6 mathematical standards.
